description: The real instance's shape after the Modrinth App reinstalled Distant Horizons (docs/v0.5/SPEC.md AC2H.6, WS-H's RW-3): the same 0.1.0 pending.json and last-apply.json as v010-dh (RigTune's DH update group: disable fabric-26.2.jar, enable its downloaded 3.3.2), but DH 3.3.2 sits at the group's target name, RigTune's download is gone, there is no mods/update, and fabric-26.2.jar is removed.
